app.title: Postcards from Space
app.tagline: Letters from the machines NASA left on other worlds.
language.label: Language
list.heading: Who wrote to you?
postcard.empty: Pick a postcard from the list to read it.
quiz.heading: Earn my stamp
quiz.correct: Correct! The stamp is in your Mission Passport.
quiz.tryAgain: Not quite. Read the letter again and have another go.
passport.heading: Mission Passport
passport.complete: Passport complete! You collected every stamp.
ladder.heading: How far away?
ladder.note: Earth is off the left edge. Each step on this scale is ten times farther than the one before.
ladder.pick: Pick a point to send that machine a radio hello.
ladder.keys: Use the arrow keys to move between points. Press Enter to send a hello.
ladder.sped: The pulse is sped up; the time shown is real.
countdown.heading: Voyager 1 countdown
countdown.before: until Voyager 1 is one light-day from Earth
countdown.after: Voyager 1 is now more than one light-day away.
teacher.heading: For teachers and parents
teacher.line: Each postcard teaches what a real NASA mission was sent to do, what it found and where it is today. Every fact is checked against NASA sources.
laser.heading: Try it: bounce a laser off me
laser.intro: Light travels about 186,000 miles (300,000 km) every second, and I am about {distance} away. Fire a laser at my prisms, then press Catch it! when you think the light is back.
laser.flying: The laser is on its way to me and back…
laser.early: You pressed at {yours}. The light came back at {real}, so you were {gap} early.
laser.late: You pressed at {yours}. The light came back at {real}, so you were {gap} late.
laser.exact: You pressed at {yours}. The light came back at {real}. Right on time!
laser.missed: The light came back after {real}. Fire again and try to catch it.
pbd.heading: Try it: find Earth in my picture
pbd.intro: On {date}, I turned my camera back toward home and took a picture. In it, Earth was only about {size} of a pixel. Can you find Earth? Click or tap a spot, or use the arrow keys and press Enter.
pbd.field: Drawing of a dark sky, {cols} squares across and {rows} down. Earth is hidden in one square.
pbd.note: A drawing of my picture, not the real photo.
pbd.found: You found Earth! That tiny dot is home.
history.heading: History
history.note: Each bar starts at launch. It ends at the last signal, or at arrival when that is the last date we have. A dot marks arrival. An arrow means the machine is still going.
history.keys: Use the arrow keys to move between machines in launch order. Press Enter to open a postcard.
journey.caption: Simplified path, real dates, not to scale.
journey.moonCaption: The Moon is about 384,400 km away on average.
journey.predict: How long did my trip from Earth to {place} take?
journey.predictTravel: How long have I been travelling?
journey.answerTravel: I have been travelling for {time}, about {about}.
